_about: PortKit's view of the features in .github/plus/features.json (the single registry). Levels: portable, adapter-required, manual, unsupported. 'verified' turns true only when the feature's transfer test passes (portkit/reports).

subtitle-parser-worst-case.reason: two Nuvio files, no new API

subtitle-style.reason: stored subtitle settings and player engine hooks

player-engines.reason: ExoPlayer/mpv integration points differ between forks

subtitle-gestures.reason: spread over player screen files that forks change often

device-subtitles.reason: subtitle picker plus player modal hooks

download-location.reason: rewrites the download pipeline and its stored records

season-downloads.reason: depends on download-location and the streams screen

library-downloads.reason: library screen and app shell navigation

addon-link-confirmation.reason: new class plus a hook in the app's deep-link handling

arabic.reason: resource files merge by string name, not by line

updater.reason: needs the target's own identity, release source, channels and signing

identity.reason: package, signing and release pipeline of Nuvio Plus; never transferred

account-and-sync.reason: build configuration of Nuvio Plus (CI script)

composeApp/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/nu.policy: transfer together; planning refuses one owner alone

composeApp/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/nuv.policy: transfer together until hunks are attributed to features; planning refuses one owner alone
transfer together until hunks are attributed to features; planning refuses one owner alone

target_contract._about: A target must look like Nuvio Mobile (Kotlin Multiplatform, package com.nuvio.app) before PortKit plans anything; a version name alone is not trusted.
